raw_response:
The figure is a line chart displaying the F1 score across different epochs for three different methods: lattice, FLAT, and OURS. The x-axis is labeled "epoch(次)" and ranges from 0 to 18, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "F1分数" and ranges from 0.55 to 0.90, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.05.

The "lattice" method is represented by a red line with square markers. Starting at approximately (0, 0.58), the line generally increases to approximately (16, 0.83). 
The "FLAT" method is represented by a blue line with circular markers. Starting at approximately (0, 0.73), the line generally increases to approximately (16, 0.87).
The "OURS" method is represented by a yellow line with triangular markers. Starting at approximately (0, 0.78), the line generally increases to approximately (16, 0.89).
